source: HAND-BUILT from research records, not a raw REST dump. Facts come from private research notes section 3 (the removed inches number entity) and section 4.2 (entities go unavailable/unknown when the coordinator has no data), plus the handoff log's 404 on number.example_mower_blade_height_inches.
scenario: Reconnect blip: the height readback sensor goes unknown, then briefly reports a false 100 (a stale/placeholder write after reconnect), then returns to the true 3.1496 in (80 mm). The adapter must report None during the blip, never 100 mm as a real readback, and must recover.
notes: While the coordinator is offline or has no data the sensor is unavailable/unknown (mammotion-ha-surface.md section 4.2).
A non-numeric state ('false') is what the handoff saw from the removed inches entity; the adapter treats any non-numeric readback as None.
100 mm is the top of the H-variant range; a placeholder at the range end must not be trusted as a readback when the value is not numeric.

steps.note: blip: a false non-numeric 100-style write arrives (handoff: entity reads None/false)
